ramadanNote: Ramadan has its own page — this list is for voluntary fasting only
whiteDaysDesc: Fasting the 13th, 14th & 15th of the lunar month is like fasting the whole month.
tasuaDesc: The 9th of Muharram — fasted alongside Ashura, following the Sunnah.
ashuraDesc: The 10th of Muharram — fasting it expiates the sins of the past year.
dhulHijjahFirst9Desc: The most beloved days to Allah for good deeds — fasting any of them is highly rewarded.
arafahDesc: The 9th of Dhul-Hijjah — fasting it expiates the sins of the past year and the year to come.
shawwal6Desc: Fast any 6 days of Shawwal after Ramadan — like fasting a whole year.
